ukraine-law (public, pinned aa90401 = main) holds 5 acts, each as one current revision taken from zakon.rada.gov.ua: the Constitution with the 2019 EU/NATO course and 2020 immunity changes, and the Civil, Criminal, Criminal Procedure and Labour codes. The Civil Procedure Code and the Code of Administrative Procedure are missing, there is no history, no Crimea law and no case law, and the text could not be checked against the official site (zakon.rada.gov.ua refused the connection).

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
